description: This file defines the GrainTypeResolver class responsible for resolving grain types in Orleans framework. It associates grain classes with their grain types, using conventions and providers.

classes.name: GrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Class for resolving and determining GrainType based on conventions or external providers.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType for a given class Type, using providers or conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainTypeByConvention
methods.description: Generates a GrainType based on naming conventions if no provider matches.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Adds generic parameters to a GrainType if the class type is a constructed generic.
